title: The Deep Rumble
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the rocky ocean below the lighthouse cliff, huge waves, reefs and sea spray, the lighthouse standing on the cliff above. Time and weather: stormy overcast day returning, cold slate-blue and grey palette, gusting wind and rain, an eerie emerald glow from the sea.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important; the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks.
Camera: over-the-shoulder from the catwalk, then tilting down the cliff to the sea; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Clouds swallow the sun again. Penny leans over the railing and points down; far below, emerald light boils and churns beneath the waves at the foot of the cliff as Tomkin and the hero crowd in beside her.
Dialogue: Penny (calm, practical, quick-witted teenage girl's voice, dryly amused, quiet and uneasy) says: "That glow is coming from below."
Sound: deep underwater rumble, rising wind, waves on rocks.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
